newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Friday conducted a round of special purchase and resale agreements in the money market at 3.25 percent, traders said.
The central bank intervened after the call loan, or overnight lending rate, was bid at the top of the bank's 2.75-3.25 percent target range, said one dealer.
"It just has to with the holdiday in the U.S. and dislocations in cash," the trader said.
The Bank of Canada set two rounds of specials in the market yesterday.
The call loan rate continued to track the top of the target range after the intervention. The three-month cash T-bill traded with a yield of 2.73 percent.
